snippet.title: Atari Games - Jammin' prototype (better visuals, playable game with audio)
snippet.description:
Turns out the hardware is roughly based on Donkey Kong, but with the added YM for sound.

Colours have been improved, although there is still some mystery as there's an additional copy of the Sprite data (with 16 colour tiles instead of 4) and even some extra Colour PROMs.  It's possible this extra data was not designed for this hardware version though, and went unused, even if these colours are a little ugly in places.
